{{Quote|Restuss and Narmle, which are what I suppose you'd call friendly rivals, hold debates every so often between the cities' finest minds. Victory for Restuss will prove our superiority over that rabble in Narmle.|Indintra Imbru Yerevan, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}

'''Indintra Imbru Yerevan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] socialite in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Restuss]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she was known for hosting salons and orchestrating the prestigious [[Great Conversation]] debates, where Restuss and its rival city of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] competed for intellectual and civic prestige. Through her charm and influence, Indintra shaped the social and [[Politics/Legends|political]] landscape of Restuss, manipulating alliances and rivalries to advance her city’s standing. Though her ambitions were initially confined to debate halls and private gatherings, the escalating war eventually reached Restuss, drawing her into events far beyond the scope of her original intrigues.

==Biography==
===The Great Conversation preparations===
{{Quote|Darling, everyone who is anyone will be attending the next 'Great Conversation' debate&mdash;including, I'm told, that nasty Narmle scholar Ingon Lakbo. His attendance would be disastrous, simply disastrous. Would you kindly deliver this suggestion to a dear friend that might lure Mr. Lakbo away from the debate?|Indintra Imbru Yerevan, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] Indintra Imbru Yerevan was a prominent socialite living in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Restuss]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Known for her elegance and influence, she played a key role in organizing events that blended intellectual debate and [[Politics/Legends|political]] maneuvering. Among these was the celebrated "[[Great Conversation]]," a recurring public debate held between the finest minds of Restuss and the rival city of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]]. Victory in these debates was a matter of civic pride, with both cities striving to demonstrate the superiority of their [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] and [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophies]].<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
In the lead-up to one such debate,<ref name="AED" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Indintra, who operated from the lounge of the [[Restuss Hotel]], learned that the noted Narmle scholar [[Ingon Lakbo]] was likely to attend as a representative for his city. Concerned that his participation would tip the balance of the debate against Restuss, she devised a plan to discreetly ensure his absence. She recruited a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to deliver a carefully worded suggestion to her trusted friend [[Briska Gil]], who also happened to be a close acquaintance of Lakbo.<ref name="AED" />

Indintra’s scheme was deceptively simple: Briska was to host an exclusive dinner party at the same time as the debate, enticing Lakbo to attend and thus preventing him from participating. Though Indintra described the plan as entirely innocent, she made it clear that Lakbo’s absence was essential to preserving Restuss’s standing. The spacer was instructed to deliver the message to Briska personally rather than through any intermediaries, ensuring its secrecy and proper delivery.<ref name="AED" />

During the journey to Briska, the spacer was accosted by a hostile thug attempting to block the delivery. After defeating the attacker, the spacer continued on to find Briska. Once the message was safely handed off, Indintra was delighted that her plan was in motion. She rewarded the spacer with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], acknowledging their assistance and noting that she had further tasks in mind to secure victory for Restuss.<ref name="AED" />

===Former Lovers===
{{Quote|My plans are proceeding nicely for the next 'Great Conversation' debate. Now that Ingon Lakbo has declined to support that rabble in Narmle, I expect their next choice will be a philosopher named Bieque Lozan-Lippid. I believe I can counter his influence with your help. Will you deliver this invitation?"<br />"How will this invitation counter the philosopher's influence in the debate?"<br />"I am inviting Bieque Lozan-Lippid's former paramour, Shaultra Loraweet, to take part in the debate on behalf of Restuss. Shaultra and Bieque parted on bad terms, and I expect her presence will cause Bieque much distraction. In the best case, he might even make a scene and be summarily ejected. Will you deliver this invitation to Shaultra?|Indintra Imbru Yerevan and a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Indintra’s scheme to secure victory for Restuss in the upcoming Great Conversation debate did not end with diverting Ingon Lakbo. Once Lakbo was out of the picture, she anticipated that Narmle would recruit another renowned philosopher, [[Bieque Lozan-Lippid]], to champion their side. To counter this threat, Indintra devised a more personal and disruptive plan. She again turned to the same trusted spacer, tasking them with delivering an invitation to [[Shaultra Loraweet]], Lozan-Lippid’s former lover, asking her to represent Restuss in the debate.<ref name="AED" />

Indintra explained that Shaultra and Bieque had parted on bitter terms following a heated argument about philosophical matters. She hoped that Shaultra’s unexpected presence would unnerve Bieque, distracting him during the debate. In an ideal outcome, the confrontation might even provoke him into causing a scene, potentially leading to his removal from the event entirely. Indintra instructed the spacer to ensure the invitation was delivered directly to Shaultra in person, warning them not to entrust it to any [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] along the way.<ref name="AED" />

On the way to deliver the invitation, the spacer was again confronted by a thug in the wilderness. After dispatching the attacker, the spacer proceeded without further incident and successfully delivered the invitation to Shaultra. Shaultra, still harboring resentment toward Bieque for past slights and their intellectual disputes, agreed to attend. Upon the spacer's return to Restuss, Indintra expressed delight, gloating about the discomfort Bieque would soon endure. She rewarded the individual with credits, remarking that she could hardly wait to see the look on Bieque’s face when confronted by his former paramour, certain that the encounter would derail Narmle’s position in the debate.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}
===Evacuation of Restuss===
{{Quote|I am investigating the military buildup here in Restuss. It has already caused the entire city to be evacuated, displacing thousands of families.|[[Marles Jacobe]], to a spacer|<ref name="NGE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 1: The Battle for Restuss</ref>}}
What had once been a friendly rivalry between Restuss and Narmle, measured in lively debates and civic pride,<ref name="AED" /> was soon eclipsed by the far greater struggle of the Galactic Civil War. A dramatic military buildup around Restuss began when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a covert research program in the city to develop the [[Star Core]], a compact [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]] intended to power [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star–scale]] operations. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] reconnaissance discovered the project, prompting both factions to construct forward bases on opposite sides of Restuss and to mobilize for a major confrontation over the device.<ref name="CtAReb">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66905&resource=features|text=''Call to Arms, Aid the Rebellion!''}}</ref><ref name="CtAEmp">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66904&resource=features|text=''Call to Arms, Fight for the Empire!''}}</ref>

With open fighting imminent, Imperial authorities ordered all civilians to evacuate the city.<ref name="Ruins">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66906&resource=features|text=Ruins of Restuss}}</ref> Indintra Imbru Yerevan, whose salons and debate planning had once defined Restuss’s social life,<ref name="AED" /> was removed along with the other noncombatants. When the [[Battle of Restuss]] culminated in the Star Core’s catastrophic detonation and the city’s destruction, Indintra was not present in the aftermath, bringing an end to her role in the city’s social and political life.<ref name="NGE" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Splendid. I can hardly wait to see the look of appalled affront on Bieque's face when he sees his paramour at the debate. He won't retain the intellectual capacity of a frightened borgle.|Indintra Imbru Yerevan upon hearing her plan succeeded|<ref name="AED" />}}
Indintra Imbru Yerevan was fair-skinned with light [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. A refined and ambitious socialite, she thrived in the political and cultural circles of Restuss. She carried herself with elegance and authority, speaking in polished, formal tones and often addressing others with pet names such as "darling." Indintra valued influence and appearances, seeing the prestigious Great Conversation debates as both intellectual contests and opportunities to assert Restuss’s social superiority over its rival city, Narmle.<ref name="AED" />

Her dialogue revealed a manipulative streak, as she orchestrated schemes to benefit Restuss while maintaining the outward appearance of propriety. Indintra’s plans were couched in seemingly innocent gestures, such as arranging a dinner party or extending a debate invitation, yet they were carefully designed to disrupt Narmle’s representation and secure victory for her own city. She showed little hesitation in exploiting personal relationships, such as inviting Shaultra Loraweet to the debate specifically to unsettle her former lover, Bieque Lozan-Lippid.<ref name="AED" />

Indintra displayed a sharp wit and a flair for the dramatic. She was quick to express displeasure when tasks were delayed, often describing such setbacks as "vexing," and her satisfaction when plans succeeded was equally emphatic. While she relied on others to carry out her errands, she retained full control over the strategy behind them, ensuring that each move served her broader goal of elevating Restuss’s reputation. Beneath her graceful demeanor lay a calculating [[Brain/Legends|mind]], adept at navigating the social and political rivalries that defined life in Rori’s cities.<ref name="AED" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Deliver this invitation into Shaultra Loraweet's hands, and on no account be distracted by any pesky protocol droids.|Indintra Imbru Yerevan, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Indintra Imbru Yerevan exhibited a refined and elegant appearance, wearing attire that befitted her status as a prominent Restuss socialite. Her [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] included a grand ball gown, featuring a cream-colored bodice and sleeves that faded into a deep red skirt. Her ensemble was complemented by [[Leather/Legends|leather]] work [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] in a pale tone and a pair of red dress slippers. While primarily a figure of culture and politics,<ref name="AED" /> Indintra also possessed light Rebel [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]].<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You could not deliver a simple suggestion? Really, you vex me beyond words.|Indintra Imbru Yerevan, upon a failed delivery quest|<ref name="AED" />}}
Indintra Imbru Yerevan was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

She originally appeared in the city of Restuss on Rori, where she offered a short two-part questline to players. The first quest tasked the player with delivering a message to Briska Gil, during which the player would encounter a hostile thug. The second quest involved delivering an invitation to Shaultra Loraweet, again with a single thug attacking along the way. These quests rewarded players with credits upon completion, with 40 credits awarded for the first and 75 credits for the second.<ref name="AED" />

As part of a major game update leading up to the Battle of Restuss, the developers reduced the amount of NPCs in the city to prepare for large-scale Player versus Player conflict. This update, introduced on [[June 27]], [[2006]] with the release of Chapter 1.1,<ref name="Chapter 1.1">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref> removed Indintra and other characters from Restuss. With her departure, her quests became permanently unavailable, and the [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] where she once appeared was later transformed into part of the ruined battlefield seen during and after the event.<ref name="NGE" />
